source: Planted for wf-intake on bench/brief's csv2json seed: a new flag on a shared parser, with nothing said about the old path.

repo.message: csv2json: CSV on stdin to a JSON array

request.text: Our exports come as TSV now. A --tsv flag on csv2json would save us a sed step.

trap: parse() in src/parse.js is shared by the CSV path, which has tests in test/csv.test.js. A build that breaks CSV while adding --tsv meets any issue that speaks only of --tsv.
must_catch: An expect line keeps CSV conversion unchanged (the existing CSV tests or npm test still pass, or CSV output is the same as before).
An expect line pins --tsv output to the same JSON as the CSV path gives for the same table.
must_not: An issue whose lines a build that breaks plain CSV input would still meet.
